origin: ts.mbt — regression for the inverted sink rule
what: A sink two links down a host chain. `HostBridge.channel.post(record)` hands `record` to the host exactly as `HostBridge.post(record)` would, but the old catalog only matched a bare-identifier receiver, so `record`'s keys looked unobserved.

globalStubs.HostBridge: { channel: { post: (msg) => { console.log("post", msg.tickKind, msg.tickAmount); return { echoedValue: msg.tickAmount * 2 }; } } }
